blocks.html: The seven events of the Ghrazi threat can appear in any order. You need to talk to Inanna to start an event. You won't be able to use the bank during the events, so make sure you are ready with armour, havensilver weapon, food, and antisanguine potion.
Two of the events are at Hollow Hill, two at the Marigold Farm, and three in Wendlewick. You do not need to prepare your teleport items, Anya can teleport you there.
